rationale: ram_zeroshot-claude-agentic: ram_ckpt_path=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ram.pth.tar, ram_sigma=0.005, ram_input_norm=global_max, ram_clamp_output=True, ram_finetune=False, ram_factor=0.5, ram_post_fbp_blend=0.8, train_n=50, val_n=5, rationale=iter-8: KNOB=ram_input_norm: adjoint_max → global_max (NEW CONFIG FAMILY #3). Family-1: zero-shot blend/factor sweep (iter-1..6); family-2: fine-tune (iter-7); both peak PSNR 12.35 at b=0.8 < baseline 12.59. Hypothesis: μ-range mismatch is in the INPUT normalization — global_max may map Mayo's μ values into RAM's training distribution. This is the 3rd config family — if it fails too, RAM is structurally bounded on Mayo (meets soft STOP criterion at iter ≥10).
